prompt: Our store ledger (`left.csv`) and the payment gateway export (`right.csv`) both break the same payout into several rows, but they split it differently — the totals agree while no individual row lines up. Every row on both sides carries the shared payout reference. Columns are date, amount, currency, reference, description; dates look like 2024-01-31. Write a `reconify.yaml` that reconciles the payout without reporting the component rows as repeated entries.
